website.headline: It starts from what you already have.
website.lead: Your website, your store, your past conversations. You confirm, GOTCHA reads.
website.foot: Nothing reaches a customer until you say so
website.title: Is this your website?

reading.headline: It reads your website so you don't have to explain it.
reading.lead: Every fact keeps a link to the page it came from. Change the page, and GOTCHA learns again.
reading.foot: You can close this tab, it keeps going

learned.headline: What it knows, and how it will sound.
learned.lead: Approve once. Everything here lands in Knowledge, where you can change it any time.
learned.foot: Nothing reaches a customer until you say so

truth.headline: The most important connection you'll make.
truth.lead: Your website explains how things work. Your store knows what's true right now. GOTCHA checks it before every answer about an order, a price or stock.
truth.foot: You decide what it may change. Reading is always safe

try.headline: Judge it on your own questions.
try.lead: Things your customers really asked. If an answer is off, fix it once and it's fixed everywhere.
try.foot: Setup mode: it only talks to your team until you go live
